csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Zombera.World.Roads; public class CheckPolyWidth { public static string Run() { var builder = Object.FindObjectOfType<CityPrefabRoadNetworkBuilder>(); var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(); if (builder == null) return "no builder"; var field = typeof(CityPrefabRoadNetworkBuilder).GetField("_lastGeneratedRoadNetwork", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic); if (field == null) return "no field"; var net = field.GetValue(builder); if (net == null) return "null net"; var roadsProp = net.GetType().GetProperty("Roads"); var roads = (System.Collections.IList)roadsProp.GetValue(net); sb.AppendLine("road count=" + roads.Count); int c = 0; foreach (var r in roads) { if (c >= 5) break; var idField = r.GetType().GetField("id"); int id = (int)idField.GetValue(r); var wField = r.GetType().GetField("widthMeters"); float w = (float)wField.GetValue(r); var ptsField = r.GetType().GetField("pointsXZ"); var pts = (System.Collections.IList)ptsField.GetValue(r); sb.AppendLine("Road" + id + " scriptWidth=" + w.ToString("F2") + " pts=" + pts.Count); c++; } return sb.ToString(); } }
